integrity: All proof steps are in RESULT.md; check.py is independently enumerated exact-rational finite evidence, not an infinite-proof replacement. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed. Priority beyond accessible inspected literature remains unverified.
scientific_limitations: Only fully mixed finite N>=3, s>=3, annealed uniform opinion-reset and a two-distinct-neighbor unanimity panel. Stationary labeled-count modes, not permutation-orbit modes; no claims for q!=2, quenched noise, zero noise or thermodynamic limits.
title: Finite multistate noisy voter modes: exact equilibrium and a two-jump six-voter staircase
